**Ribbon graphs and their invariants derived from quantum groups**

*Ribbon Graphs and Their Invariants Derived*

26 pp, 48 sections.

**Abstract.** The generalization of Jones polynomial of links to the case of graphs in R 3 is presented. It is constructed as the functor from the category of graphs to the category of representations of the quantum group.
